test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
If the series is to be continued, which figure should come in place of the question mark (?)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d454e47b5b1ae80ce12e1fc994359d64f654206203e3225a4cfdfe914ae2682e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first and last elements of the first row interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/600285e37cd3f3d584bb59304858e8b72b0c6f225524969b59c3f89828c3d034.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The first row elements shift clockwise.

The bottom row elements interchange positions.

The fourth element of the first row from the left is replaced by new element subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/135bf01bc2cab689dac4eddd3edcd56468e872015000b90c7196d9fc83ab7d49.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0335c33f713a7c4cffeefe8059b73a7f6cd14ca9de7cb931ab0dca5c5cf2796.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
